etymology.historical_story: No defensible word history can be reconstructed from this packet. A corpus can contain names, abbreviations, typographical errors, and fragments from other languages alongside ordinary Malay vocabulary. The spelling shes alone does not distinguish those possibilities. Its original sentence and source must therefore be recovered before assigning an origin, pronunciation, or lexical meaning.
